fields.game/data/audio_cues.json:door_knock: Cue id presented dynamically: AudioPolicy looks every cue up by the id its caller passes (cues[cue_id]), and DoorProp presents interaction.door_knock from a const. Same read shape as every other cue id, which predate the baseline.
fields.game/data/audio_cues.json:klaxon: Cue id presented dynamically: OrisonV2StreetTraffic presents traffic.klaxon by the id its class record names (street_traffic.json classes[].warning/brake), validated against its WARNING_CUES const; AudioPolicy looks it up by that id (cues[cue_id]).
